title: Discriminator-Actor-Critic: Addressing Sample Inefficiency and Reward Bias in Adversarial
summary: Discriminator-Actor-Critic (DAC) fixes the reward bias and sample inefficiency of adversarial imitation learning by using off-policy training with a discriminator-derived reward, learning from a handful of expert trajectories in a training-worker/evaluation-worker setup. Meridian is trialling it to clone operator behaviour from demonstration logs without hand-written reward functions.
